Episodes.Title: Welcome to Widow's Bay!
Episodes.Actors: Christopher C. James, Matthew Rhys, Jimmy Shirts
Episodes.Plot: An isolated coastal town faces a modernization push. Mayor Tom Loftis drives a high-stakes tourism initiative. Dense fog rolls in, triggering ancient curse warnings from locals and mysterious disappearances that threaten civic order.

Episodes.Title: Lodging
Episodes.Plot: The mayor stays alone at a notoriously haunted local inn to debunk supernatural rumors for tourists, but a bizarre midnight encounter with a mysterious guest tests his sanity as the island's dark history begins to wake.

Episodes.Title: The Inaugural Swim
Episodes.Plot: It's time for the annual beach opening. Lay out a towel as the mayor "tests the waters." Unrelated: Do not pick up hitchhikers.

Episodes.Title: Beach Reads
Episodes.Plot: Make sure you pack a good read for the beach. (We do not recommend self-help books on the island.)

Episodes.Title: What to Expect on Your Trip
Episodes.Plot: We apologize for the curfew. Please remain calm as we determine what's happening. On a separate note, keep your teenagers inside after dark.

Episodes.Title: Our History
Episodes.Actors: Kevin F. Conway, Eli D Goss, Matthew Rhys
Episodes.Plot: A beautiful tale of marriage, loyalty, and a love that endures beyond lifetimes. That's all.

Episodes.Title: Seasickness
Episodes.Plot: Set out to sea with Mayor Loftis and cherished local figure, Wyck. They are attending to some business - best to simply enjoy the voyage.

Episodes.Title: Your Baggage
Episodes.Actors: David Armstrong, Pat Fitz, Ava Gaudet
Episodes.Plot: Don't worry about misplaced luggage. Old baggage always resurfaces in Widow's Bay.

Episodes.Title: Emergency Shelter
Episodes.Plot: Please seek shelter should a centuries-old storm rage toward the island and plunge us into darkness. Enjoy a card game.

Episodes.Title: We Hope You Enjoyed Your Time!
Episodes.Actors: Vincent Flynn, Shawn Jain, Matthew Rhys
Episodes.Plot: We understand that hard choices had to be made and we may never be the same, but we hope you'll visit again.
